mapper.select: SELECT m.message_id FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.room_id IN #{roomId} AND m.deleted_yn = 'N' AND m.message_type IN ('TEXT', 'FILE') AND (LOWER(m.content) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_message_files f WHERE f.message_id = m.message_id AND f.deleted_yn = 'N' AND LOWER(f.original_name) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\')) ORDER BY m.message_id DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
